title: ‘Hindi krimen ang magprotesta’: Families, lawyers camp outside Bagong Diwa as 230 protesters remain detained
summary: Families, relatives, and supporters of rallyists arrested during Sunday’s protest actions gathered outside Camp Bagong Diwa, waiting for updates and access to their detained loved ones.
